card.name: Mixed spots in Canadian and British texts
card.fires_on: Scattered words in Canadian or British-style texts, such as 'politician' after 'English', parts of Quebec law and committee names, and the 'q' in kBq/MBq. No single word type unites them.

modes.description: The q in kBq/MBq or a digit inside a converted dose range.

modes.label: English politician biography
modes.description: The word politician after 'English' in a short biography opening.
modes.example: was an English<< politician>> and collector of antiquities.

card.writes: It pushes toward US and North American place names and away from British political terms.
card.plain: It fires on scattered words in Canadian or British texts and nudges the model toward American places over British ones.
